notes: Trading tools for the member's own Nexus paper accounts, on their own opt-in tool list. Each tool calls one Nexus Trades API route with the member's Skylit API key. Arguments named like a path placeholder fill the path; on GET the rest go in the query string, on POST the rest are the JSON body. Hand-kept: scripts/sync.py --check fails when a tool and the spec disagree.
pendingProduction: Tools and arguments marked "x-requires": "second-prod-set" (options and stock limits and stops, options stop-losses, the wallet order routes, adds, futures stop-limit and size change, futures in nexus_trades) are on the Nexus staging API only. Serve them once production has them (nexus #795, #796 and the #791 port). The agent account and nexus_wallet are on production.

tools.name: nexus_capabilities
tools.title: Nexus trading capabilities
tools.description: What this key can trade in Nexus right now: asset classes, order types, futures contracts and accounts. Read only, it changes nothing. Call it before any order so you never have to guess.

tools.name: nexus_trades
tools.title: List Nexus trades
tools.description: Your Nexus paper options and stock trades. Read only. Filter by status and page with limit and offset. account: agent lists your bot's agent wallet instead. assetClass: futures lists one futures account's open positions and closed trades (needs the second production set). With test: true it lists your test log (your 10 newest test orders) instead.

assetClass.description: futures lists one futures account's positions and closed trades. Leave it out for options and stocks.

account.description: Options and stocks: agent lists your bot's wallet; leave it out for yours. Futures: practice (or left out), agent, evaluation, funded or an account id.

test.description: true lists your test log instead of your trades.

tools.name: nexus_trade
tools.title: Read a Nexus trade
tools.description: One of your Nexus paper options or stock trades, with its exits. Read only. Works with a test order's id too.

id.description: The trade's id, from nexus_open_trade or nexus_trades.

tools.name: nexus_open_trade
tools.title: Open a Nexus paper trade
tools.description: Places a PAPER trade on the user's own Nexus account. Options and stocks go to their Nexus paper wallet; futures go to their practice account, or to an evaluation or funded account named in account. Nothing is sent to a broker. The server prices the fill from the live market when the call arrives. A real order counts like one placed by hand: it shows in their trades, stats and ranks, and unless the trade is private, people who copy their trades get it too. Send test: true first: the order is checked and priced like a real one, then kept in the test log and never placed. Confirm the order with the user before sending test: false. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry, so a retry can't place a second order. account: agent sends any order to the user's bot account, which never counts anywhere public. Options are bought to open. Market orders fill now; an options limit, or a stock limit or stop, rests on the wallet and holds back buying power until it fills (manage it with nexus_working_orders, nexus_modify_order and nexus_cancel_order). Already holding the contract? Use nexus_add_to_trade instead of a second open. Call nexus_capabilities first: limits, stops and stop_limit need the second production set.

assetClass.description: Which book the order goes to.

contract.description: Options shorthand, like SPY 600C 10/16. Send this, or ticker, strike, direction and expiration.

ticker.description: A symbol like SPY. For futures, a product like NQ (the front month) or one contract like NQZ26.

side.description: Stocks and futures. Options are always bought to open.

quantity.description: Options 1 to 1,000 contracts, stocks 1 to 100,000 shares, futures 1 to 100 contracts.

price.description: Options and stocks: a fill price the user got elsewhere, taken only inside a small window around the live quote.

ifOutside.description: When price is outside the window: refuse, or fill at market.

orderType.description: Options take market or limit. Stocks take market, limit or stop. Futures take market, limit, stop or stop_limit (with stopPrice and limitPrice). Options and stock limits and stops, and futures stop_limit, need the second production set.

limitPrice.description: A limit or stop-limit: the price the order rests at. Options and stocks in cents, like 2.45.

stopPrice.description: A stock stop, or a futures stop or stop-limit: the price that triggers it.

timeInForce.description: Options and stock limits and stops: day works until 4:00 pm ET, gtc until the option's last trading day or 90 days for a stock.

stopLoss.description: Futures: a stop loss placed with the entry.

takeProfit.description: Futures: a take profit placed with the entry.

trailingStop.description: Futures: the stop loss trails the price. Needs stopLoss.

reduceOnly.description: Futures: only take contracts off a position the user holds, never open, add or flip.

account.description: agent sends any order to the user's bot account. Futures also take practice (the default), evaluation, funded, or an account id from nexus_capabilities. For options and stocks, leave it out for the user's own paper wallet.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this order. Reuse the same one on a retry: you get the first order back and nothing new is placed.

test.description: true checks and prices the order, then keeps it in the test log instead of placing it. Use it for the first call.

tools.name: nexus_exit_trade
tools.title: Trim or close a Nexus paper trade
tools.description: Sells some or all of one of the user's Nexus PAPER options or stock trades (on a short stock trade, buys it back). Nothing is sent to a broker. Send quantity to trim, or closeAll: true to close what's left, not both. At market by default. orderType limit with limitPrice rests until the market gets there; a stock also takes orderType stop with stopPrice. On an options trade, stopLoss and takeProfit arm a stop and a target on the STOCK's price, not the option's: when the stock trades through a level, the contracts sell at the option's live bid. Resting exits and stops need the second production set. A test trade's exit is always a test, so rehearse with a test trade first. Confirm with the user before exiting a real trade. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry.

id.description: The trade's id, from nexus_open_trade or nexus_trades.

price.description: A fill price the user got elsewhere, taken only inside a small window around the live quote.

ifOutside.description: When price is outside the window: refuse, or fill at market.

orderType.description: limit closes at your price. stop closes a stock when it trades through stopPrice, or arms an options stop on the stock's price.

limitPrice.description: A limit exit: the least to take per contract or share (the most to pay to cover a short).

stopPrice.description: A stop exit. A stock: the price that sets it off. An option: the stock price the stop fires at, the same as stopLoss.

timeInForce.description: Limit and stock stop exits. An options stop takes none: it stays on until it fires, is cancelled, or the contract expires.

stopLoss.description: Options only: the STOCK price the stop fires at. On a call it sits under the stock's price, on a put over it.

takeProfit.description: Options only: the STOCK price the target fires at. With stopLoss it's one bracket order.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this exit. Reuse the same one on a retry.

test.description: Optional. The trade decides: a test trade's exit is always a test.

tools.name: nexus_futures_account
tools.title: Read a Nexus futures account
tools.description: Balance, open positions and loss rules for one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation or funded (when exactly one is running), or an account id from nexus_capabilities.

tools.name: nexus_futures_orders
tools.title: Nexus futures order history
tools.description: Order and fill history for one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts, newest first. Read only.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

before.description: Only orders placed before this time, like 2026-10-09T14:00:00Z.

tools.name: nexus_futures_close
tools.title: Close or flatten Nexus paper futures
tools.description: Closes one futures position, or flattens the whole account, at market on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account. Nothing is sent to a broker. Send ticker or closeAll: true, not both. test: true previews the close against what the account really holds and places nothing. Confirm with the user before a real close. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

ticker.description: The position to close, like NQ or NQZ26.

closeAll.description: true flattens every position in the account.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this close. Reuse the same one on a retry.

test.description: true previews the close and places nothing.

tools.name: nexus_futures_working_orders
tools.title: Resting Nexus futures orders
tools.description: Limit, stop and bracket orders resting on one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

tools.name: nexus_futures_order
tools.title: Read a Nexus futures order
tools.description: One order on one of the user's Nexus paper futures accounts. Read only.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

orderId.description: The order's id, from nexus_open_trade, nexus_futures_working_orders or nexus_futures_orders.

tools.name: nexus_futures_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel a resting Nexus futures order
tools.description: Cancels one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account. Nothing is sent to a broker. With test: true it acts on a test order in the test log only, never a real one. Confirm with the user before cancelling a real order.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

test.description: true acts on a test order in the test log only.

tools.name: nexus_futures_modify_order
tools.title: Move or resize a resting Nexus futures order
tools.description: Moves the price of one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account, or changes a resting entry's size (needs the second production set). Nothing is sent to a broker. Send price, quantity, or both: all of it changes or none does. On a stop-limit, price is its limit and stopPrice its trigger. A bigger size is checked like a new order and loses its place in line; a smaller one keeps it; the stop and target follow. A test order's price can't be moved, but test: true can rehearse a size change. Read the order with nexus_futures_order first and confirm the change with the user.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

quantity.description: A resting entry's new size, 1 to 100. To take it all off, cancel instead.

stopPrice.description: A stop-limit's new trigger, until a trade reaches it.

test.description: Optional. The order decides: on a test order only a size change can be rehearsed.

tools.name: nexus_futures_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel resting Nexus futures orders
tools.description: Cancels every resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER futures account, or just one contract's orders. Nothing is sent to a broker. Send cancelAll: true or ticker, not both. With test: true it cancels the account's test orders in the test log only. Confirm with the user before cancelling real orders.

account.description: practice, agent (the user's bot account), evaluation, funded, or an account id.

cancelAll.description: true cancels every resting order on the account.

ticker.description: Cancel only this contract's orders, like NQ.

test.description: true cancels the account's test orders in the test log only.

tools.name: nexus_wallet
tools.title: Read a Nexus paper wallet
tools.description: The user's options and stocks paper wallet (main) or their bot's (agent): cash, buying power, realized P/L and open positions, all in cents. Read only. Size new trades from buyingPowerCents, which is cash minus what resting buys hold back. openMarketValueCents and equityCents are left out when a position hasn't been marked yet.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

tools.name: nexus_add_to_trade
tools.title: Add to a Nexus paper trade
tools.description: Buys more of one of the user's open Nexus PAPER options or stock trades at market (options at the live ask, stocks at the live price). Nothing is sent to a broker. The average, totals and P/L update the way they do when the user adds in Nexus, and the trade's wallet pays (an agent trade pays from the agent wallet). Each add is 1 to 1,000 contracts or 1 to 100,000 shares, and the position can't grow past that. An add to a test trade's id is a test add, so rehearse with a test trade first. Confirm with the user before adding to a real trade. Always make up a clientOrderId and reuse it if you retry.

id.description: The trade's id, from nexus_open_trade, nexus_trades, or the tradeId of a 409 duplicate_position.

quantity.description: How many more contracts or shares.

price.description: A fill price the user got elsewhere, taken only inside a small window around the live quote.

ifOutside.description: When price is outside the window: refuse, or fill at market.

clientOrderId.description: Your own id for this add. Reuse the same one on a retry.

test.description: Optional. The trade decides: an add to a test trade is a test add, and true on a real trade adds nothing.

tools.name: nexus_working_orders
tools.title: Resting Nexus options and stock orders
tools.description: Options and stock orders resting on the user's paper wallet (main) or their bot's (agent), oldest first: limits, stock stops, and options stop-losses and targets. The main wallet also shows orders placed on the Options Desk in Nexus. Read only.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

tools.name: nexus_order
tools.title: Read a Nexus options or stock order
tools.description: One options or stock order on a paper wallet as it stands now, in any status: working, filled, cancelled, rejected or expired. A filled order shows fillPrice and tradeId; a fired options stop shows firedLeg and triggerPrice (the stock price). Read only. Works with a test order's id too.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

tools.name: nexus_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel a Nexus options or stock order
tools.description: Cancels one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER wallet and gives back the buying power it held. Nothing is sent to a broker. Safe to send twice. A stop that's already been set off is filling and can't be cancelled (409 stop_triggered). A test order's id cancels it in the test log only. Confirm with the user before cancelling a real order.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

test.description: Optional. true only ever acts on a test order in the test log.

tools.name: nexus_modify_order
tools.title: Change a Nexus options or stock order
tools.description: Changes one resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER wallet in place. Nothing is sent to a broker. A limit takes price (the new limit) and quantity. A stock stop takes price (the new stop). An options stop takes stopLoss and takeProfit (STOCK prices), quantity, or price when it has only one level. A bigger buy has to fit buying power, and a buy moved above the ask fills right away. Test orders can't be modified, so there's no test mode here. Read the order with nexus_order first and confirm the change with the user.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

price.description: The new limit, or the new stop on a stock stop or a one-level options stop. In cents.

quantity.description: The new size: up to 1,000 contracts or 100,000 shares.

stopLoss.description: Options stops: the new stock price the stop fires at.

takeProfit.description: Options stops: the new stock price the target fires at.

tools.name: nexus_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel resting Nexus options and stock orders
tools.description: Cancels every resting order on the user's Nexus PAPER wallet, options stops included, or just one underlying's orders. Nothing is sent to a broker, and nothing is closed: positions stay open. Send cancelAll: true or ticker, not both. Stops that are already filling are skipped and listed in meta.stopsFilling. With test: true it cancels the wallet's test orders in the test log only. Confirm with the user before cancelling real orders.

book.description: main is the user's own paper wallet, agent is their bot's.

cancelAll.description: true cancels every resting order on the wallet.

ticker.description: Cancel only this underlying's orders, like SPY.

test.description: true cancels the wallet's test orders in the test log only.
